violation_type.title: Parent right to enter and examine operation without advance notice (26 TAC §744.521(1))
violation_type.short_title: Parent right to enter and examine operation without advance notice
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation is only allowing parents access to the operation during the hours that the front office staff is present and during special events.
